note: Sierra Leone: ECOWAS citizens work under the rules for nationals (the ecowas list). Under the Work Permit Act, 2023 (Act No. 11 of 2023, Gazette 24A of 28 April 2023, in force 19 April 2023), the Minister may issue a special work permit to non-citizen artists, performers, professional athletes, researchers and consultants who intend to work in Sierra Leone for a period not exceeding three months (section 22); longer work needs the Act's ordinary work permit. The Act's PDF on SierraLII is a scan with no text layer, so it was read by eye (pages 2 and 13). No days of work without a permit are named.

sources.title: SierraLII, Work Permit Act, 2023 (Act No. 11 of 2023), as published in the Sierra Leone Gazette 24A of 28 April 2023
sources.said: 22. The Minister may issue a special work permit to non-citizen artists, performers, professional athletes, researchers and consultants who intend to work in Sierra Leone for a period not exceeding 3 months.
